description: This file defines the AimGuardrail class, which extends CustomGuardrail to implement security guardrails for LLM calls using the Aim security platform. It includes methods for request pre-processing, moderation, analysis, and active output guarding via HTTP and WebSocket connections, plus configuration setup.

classes.name: AimGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail implementation integrating Aim security platform with LLM calls, handling request and output analysis, blocking, anonymization, and WebSocket streaming.
